conclusion: 05-5_NPU演示 is a substantive Milianke DR1M90GEG400 NPU project and supplies the Arm NN/ONNX path plus candidate hardware artifacts. Its mixed generated metadata, missing base Linux files and external SDK build assumptions prevent treating it as a reproducible MLK-F3P-CZ02 SD source. The primary Task 025 blocker remains board-project identity, not absence of an NPU demo.
